evidence.detail: Container inherits from Munch; munch is still an active dependency
55 files import Container directly; total import lines (including 'from shared import container') reach 128 — pervasive use across the codebase
Container is a dict subclass with arbitrary attribute access; slotted replacements require knowing all attributes per class in advance

triage.notes: Scope is large: each Container usage would need to be converted to a typed dataclass or attrs class with explicit slots, requiring per-site analysis of what attributes are set. A pragmatic first step would be to replace Container in one isolated module (e.g. news.py) as a proof of concept and measure the memory/perf benefit before committing to the full refactor.
